_config.stream_algorithm: numpy.SeedSequence(8 entropy uint32 words, HRLD domain, frame, component); NOT keyed by rho or snr

receiver.logloss: mean log2(1+exp(-(1-2b)L)) over 2048 coded bits, L=log P0/P1

environment.torch_binding_authority: receiver context build; verified before first receiver run

c1.delays: L distinct delays uniformly without replacement from {0..100} (rng.choice(101, L, replace=False)), sorted
c1.ray_doppler: nu = 2 cos(theta), theta ~ U[0, 2pi) per ray
c1.ray_gain: CN(0, 1/(L R)) => tap power 1/L (uniform), expected total power 1, NO renormalisation
c1.seeds: SeedSequence(entropy_words + [C1_DOMAIN, frame, Lkey, component]); channel Lkey = L, message/noise Lkey = 0; not keyed by rho, snr, arm
c1.rho_shim: transmit power 1: pilot sqrt(rho) ZC, data sqrt(1-rho) QPSK, sigma2 = 10^(-snr/10); obs / sqrt(2(1-rho)); receiver sees rho = .5 system
c1.flat_prior: tau_d = 1/K for all columns (total prior energy 1), no energy estimation
c1.slep_prior: frozen M2 M_full config (kappa .3, drop 0, mode full) + M2 energy-estimation rules
c1.genie: all L true distinct delays handed to the DPSS refit (no 8-delay cap); nothing else from truth

c1i.pairing: observations identical to out/c1_map (entropy_hex, c1 domain/streams, rho .3, snr 6.5); arms differ only in the receiver
c1i.FULL_R4: SPg_flat (genie delays, flat prior tau_d = 1/K) with rounds = 4
c1i.FROZEN: round-1 refit output cached and returned by every later refit; gain_mode fixed; rounds 2
c1i.WARM: round-1 refit output := (1-l) c_pilot + l c_true; c_true = lstsq projection of the true tap sequences on the SAME DPSS columns of the round-1 design (truth used only here); rounds 4; later rounds unmodified
c1i.eps: eps_of semantics of driver_c1: ||H - H^||_F^2 / N = sum_l ||a_l - M_l h_l||^2 / N

c1ib2.pairing: observations identical to driver_c1 / driver_c1i / driver_c1ib for the same (entropy_hex 129abc..., frame, L, rho, SNR); arms differ only in (rounds R, inner updates T)
c1ib2.receiver: SPg_flat FULL (genie delays, flat prior, K = 8 L): IntervenedRefine(mode=full) under dpss_rx.vector_prior, interventions._instrumented(rounds=R, iterations=T, gain_mode=joint)
c1ib2.arms: R<rounds>T<updates>; rows 1..R of an R-round run equal the R'-round run for R' <= R (sequential rounds; checked in the analysis)
c1ib2.eps: eps_of semantics of driver_c1: ||H - H^||_F^2 / N

pairing: all rows of each frame (population: each snr cell frame) share (channel_seed, physical_gains_sha256, info_sha256, noise_sha256)
